name: pokedex-extension-root
description: Root workspace for the PokéDex VS Code extension.

scripts.install:all: cd webview-ui && npm install && cd ../extension && npm install
scripts.build:all: cd webview-ui && npm run build && cd ../extension && npm run compile
scripts.package: npm run build:all && cd extension && npx vsce package
scripts.ready: echo 'Trainer! Your PokéDex is ready for deployment. Run npm run build:all then hit F5!'
